<My Account>
Question: "I can't register."
Answer: "Here are some reasons why you are unable to register an account:

1. You may have entered the incorrect Policy/Certificate Number/New NRIC Number/Old NRIC
Number/Passport Number/Mobile Phone Number

2. The product is not supported by MyAccount

3. Your Policy/Certificate Number/New NRIC Number/Old NRIC Number/Passport Number/Mobile
Phone Number is/are not listed in our records."

Question: "I didn't receive an activation code", Answer: "If you made a TAC code request, it might
take a few minutes for it to be sent to your mobile number.You can look out for the sms under the
number 63633."

Question: "I forgot my password", Answer: "No worries! Just follow these simple steps to reset it:

Step 1: Click "Forgot Password?" on the MyAccount page.

Step 2: Enter your ID i.e MYKad/ Passport/Army identification number

Step 3: Proceed to log in with the new AC ; sent to your pre-registered mobile number

Step 4: Change your password after logging in"

Question: "I want to update my personal details", Answer: "You can call 1-300-88-1007 for inquires
related to claims.

Operating Hours:
9:00am - 5:00pm (Monday to Friday)
Closed on Saturday, Sunday and Public Holidays"

1. Login Website My Account

3. Click "Download" in Action Column"

Question: "I am unable to login, I'm new user", Answer: "For New User: Ahh, a newbie. I hope you'll
be able to enjoy the Etiqa+ app with these steps:

1. Ensure you've install the latest version of the app

2. Do set your region on Play Store/App Store to any of the following countries:
- Malaysia
- Indonesia
- Myanmar
- Brunei
- Cambodia
- India
- Singapore
- Hong Kong
- Laos

3. Check your device and make sure it's updated to the latest version of Android (Min v5.0 & above)/
iOS (Min v15.0 & above)

4. For registration to Etiqa+ App account, you may refer step-by-step below:

Step 1: Tap on Login button
Step 2: Click Create an account
Step 3: Fill in the provided details such as ID type, ID Number, Mobile Number, Email and
Verification Captcha
Step 4: Tick the consent box
Step 5: Tap on register button
Step 6: Fill in OTP code and tap on verify button
Step 7: Setup new login credentials details and tap on confirm button
Step 8: Account successfully created!"

Question: "I am unable to login, I'm existing user", Answer: "For existing user: Could you try out
these steps and let me know how it goes?

1. Ensure you are installing the latest version of the Etiqa+ App

2. Do check to make sure your device is updated to the latest version of Android (Min v5.0 & above)/
iOS (Min v15.0 & above)

<!-- page 4 -->
3. For registration to Etiqa+ App account, you may refer step-by-step below:

Step 1: Tap on Login button
Step 2: Tap on update login details button
Step 3: Fill in the provided details such as ID type, ID Number, Mobile Number, Email and
Verification Captcha
Step 4: User will be asked to provide Corporate policy no. If do not have this policy, may tap on
provide later to proceed.
Step 5: Key-in OTP code
Step 6: Setup new login credentials details and tap on confirm button
Step 7: Account successfully created!"


Question: "I didn't receive the OTP code", Answer: "Could you try out these steps and let me know
how it goes?

1. Check the mobile number you provided to ensure it is correct and within the coverage area
(Malaysia)

2. Are you currently experiencing poor network coverage? If you are, there might be delays in
receiving the OTP code so do be patient.

3. Kindly ensure the SMS provider's number (62033) isn't blocked or save as spam.

4. Search for our SMS provider's number (62033) on your message app to see if you've received the
OTP code.

5. Restart your mobile phone and request the OTP code again."


Question: "I cannot view my policy details", Answer: "Can you give these steps a try and let me know
how it goes?

1. Ensure you have keyed-in the correct NRIC/Passport/Army/Police in the profile as per registered
policy/certificate (capital letter, no space, no hyphen)

2.Check to see if the phone number in the policy/certificate is the same one you used to sign up for a
Etiqa+ App account

3. You can try keying in your active policy/certificate number in the provided space under the My
Policy section"

Question: "How do I submit a medical claim?", Answer: "Simply follow the steps below:

1. Login to Etiqa+ App
2. Go to the "Claims" tab
3. Choose "Hospital & Clinic Bill Claim"
4. Select the policy you would like to claim from
5. Complete the details and submit the claim"

Question: "How do I download a statement?", Answer: "Simply follow these steps:

1. Login to Etiqa+ App
2. Go to "Explore our services" > Scroll to the left
3. Go to"Download Documents""

Question: "How do I make a Guarantee Letter (GL) request?", Answer: "If it is your own policy,
follow the steps below:

1. Login to Etiqa+ App
2. Tap on the "Help" icon
3. Go to "Etiqa Healthcare"

For Group Policy under Company, follow the steps below:

1. Login to Etiqa+ App
2. Go to "Healthcare"
3. Go to "Group Policy under Company"
4. Go to "Request Outpatient GL""

Question: "How do I retrieve my username?", Answer: "Simply follow these steps:

1. Open Etiqa+ App
2. Tap on the "Login" button on the top right of the screen
3. Tap on "Forgot Username?"
4. Key in your email address you used to register for an Etiqa+ account and proceed
5. You will receive an email containing your username"

<!-- page 6 -->
Question: "How do I reset my password?", Answer: "(Before Login)
Simply follow these steps:

1. Open Etiqa+ App
2. Tap on the "Login" button on the top right of the screen
3. Tap on the "Login" button
4. Tap on "Forgot Password?"
5. Key in your email address you used to register for an Etiqa+ account and proceed
6. Check your email inbox for our email and follow the steps

(After Login)
Simply follow these steps:

1. Login to Etiqa+ App
2. Tap on the "Profile" icon
3. Tap on the "Edit Profile" button
4. Tap on "Change Password""

<Drive Less Save More (DLSM) related>
Question: "What is DLSM?", Answer: "I'm glad you asked! 😁️

Drive Less Save More is our way of saying thanks to you for saving the environment with rebates of
up to 30% per year when you drive less.

The best part? This add-on is FREE when you sign up for a Motor Insurance or Takaful plan!

Just opt in this add-on if you're buying online or get your agent to do it for you.

You'll receive instructions and reminders on how to activate and make cash rebate requests closer to
the date. Don't worry, it's easy.

Good things must be shared so do share with your family and friends about this too!"

Question: "When can I make a DLSM activation submission?", Answer: "🇦🇹️You may upload your
odometer reading and car plate number via Etiqa+ App on the effective date of the policy.

Activating your DLSM add-on is pretty simple. 😉️

Here's how:

1) Download the Etiqa+ App from Play Store/App Store and sign up for an account.

2) Log in and tap 'My Policy' on the home screen to view your Motor policy/policies with the Drive
Less Save More add-on.

3) Tap 'Activate' on the add-on to proceed.

4) Fill in the required information and proceed to take photos of your car plate number and
odometer reading.

5) There will be instructions on how to take your photos. Ensure you follow the instructions
carefully.

<!-- page 12 -->
6) Review your submission and tap on the agreement checkbox. Submit you application and you're
done!

7) The status on your Motor policy will changed to 'in progress'. You may proceed to make cash
rebate requests once the status indicates it is ready."

Question: "When can I make a DLSM rebate submission?", Answer: "It's really up to you! 😊️

You can submit your next odometer reading anytime and as frequently as you wish, as long as there
is a minimum of 10 days between each upload.

Getting ready to claim your cash rebate? Just follow these steps and you're good to go!

1) Log in to the Etiqa+ App.

2) Tap 'My Policy' to view your Motor policy/policies with the Drive Less Save More add-on.

3) Tap 'Submit Now' on the add-on to
proceed.

4) Fill in the required information and take a photo of your car's odometer reading. Do ensure you
follow all the instructions when you capture the photos.

5) Review your submission, check the agreement box before and submit.

6) Now all you have to do is wait while our team reviews your submission and update you when the
rebate is paid out. 😎️"

Question: "How is the rebate calculated?", Answer: "Alright. Let me put on my Math Wizard cap on
️ Looks good right?

Basically, the cash rebate is calculated on a daily basis, as a percentage of your basic premium
(minus No Claim Discount). You can refer to the table below:

a) Tier 1
- 0-14 (Kilometre Range per day)
- 0.082% (Daily REBATE %)
- 30% (Total REBATE % for a year)

b) Tier 2
- 15-28 (Kilometre Range per day)
- 0.055% (Daily REBATE %)
- 20% (Total REBATE % for a year)

c) Tier 3

<!-- page 13 -->
- 29-42 (Kilometre Range per day)
- 0.027% (Daily REBATE %)
- 10% (Total REBATE % for a year)

Note: Fractions of distance driven will be rounded up to the nearest km."

Question: "When will I receive the DLSM rebate?", Answer: "We will credit it into your account
within 5 - 7 working days from the submission date. 😄️"

Question: "Why can't I opt in DLSM?", Answer: "🔎️ You may not be eligible to opt in if you do not
meet the following criterias :

- Age of Covered Person 25 - 80 years old
- Age of Vehicle 0 - 20 years
- Sum Covered RM12,000 and above
- Category Used for private purposes"

Question: "Having problem to upload pictures via real time?", Answer: "Pssst. Let me teach you a
secret way to upload your images. Please don't tell my boss, okay? ️

Here's what you're going to do:

1) Log in to Etiqa+ App.

2) Click "My Policy" to find your Motor policy with the Drive Less Save More add-on.

3) Tap "Activate" or 'Submit Now' to start the activate/rebate process.

4) Fill in the required information and tap 'Having issues taking a photo now?".

5) Select the issue you face and then tap 'Proceed to upload photo'.

6) Tap 'Upload'.

7) Select your gallery and upload the relevant photo(s).

8) Proceed to review your submission and tap to submit.

Ta-da, all done! Hope these steps work out for you. 😎️"
</Drive Less Save More (DLSM) related>
